info.title: Tempera Clearing API
info.description: Canonical preparation, authority binding, durable commit, and evidence reads for consequential Tempera actions. A prepared action is non-executable until a complete authority-bearing action is proposed and committed.

get.summary: Readiness probe over the contract source lock and every hard dependency

200.description: Required contract and authentication dependencies are ready

post.summary: Validate a canonical action envelope without persisting or dispatching it

200.description: Action is structurally valid but was not persisted or dispatched

post.summary: Persist a non-executable canonical effect before authority is issued
post.description: Validates the prepared effect and source-locked adapter, binds it to one workspace/action/idempotency identity, and creates no provider outbox task.

200.description: Exact replay of an existing preparation

201.description: Prepared effect persisted without authority or dispatch

post.summary: Bind exact authority and Risk evidence to a prior prepared effect

get.summary: Read one prepared or authority-bound action
List the hash-linked events of one action

200.description: One page of hash-linked authority-bound action events

post.summary: Live-verify Risk evidence, then durably commit the exact previously prepared and authority-bound action
post.description: The only Clearing operation that can produce an effect outside the database. It is reachable only for an action that was already prepared and proposed, and it consumes the authority admission exactly once.

202.description: Commit decision and dispatch task durably recorded

scopes.clearing:actions:read: Read tenant-scoped Clearing actions and events
scopes.clearing:actions:commit: Commit an exact previously prepared action

ActionId.name: id
ActionId.description: The canonical action identifier, matching the AIP-122 pattern actions/*.

PageSize.name: pageSize
PageSize.description: Maximum events to return. Defaults to 50 and is capped at 500.

PageToken.name: pageToken
PageToken.description: The nextPageToken returned by a previous call.

Status.description: The google.rpc.Status error envelope required of every Tempera API (AIP-193).

code.description: The HTTP status code, repeated in the body so the envelope is self-describing.

status.description: The canonical google.rpc.Code name, for example INVALID_ARGUMENT.

message.description: A developer-facing description that is safe to log and safe to show.

details.description: Structured error details. Present but empty when there are none.

requestId.description: The server-assigned request identifier, mirrored from the x-request-id response header.

riskEvidenceEnvelope.description: The original signed Risk Clearing evidence envelope. Clearing verifies it against Risk's live reservation before consuming final admission, then persists the exact envelope for durable outcome transitions. It is evidence, never execution authority.

nextPageToken.description: The token to pass as pageToken for the next page, or null on the last page.
